# Getting help

## lifepete.com

For your account on the hosted service — signing in, a passkey you lost, your data,
deleting your account — email ahmed.elghareeb@proton.me from the address you'd like the
answer at. Don't put account details in a public issue.

Your data is yours to take at any time: **Settings → Data Export** downloads a full JSON
backup or your sessions as CSV.
[PRIVACY.md](../PRIVACY.md) says what is stored and who can see it.

## Self-hosting and everything else

- **How do I…?** —
  [Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/lanterno/beats/discussions/categories/q-a).
  Search first; pairing and setup questions have often been answered.
- **Something is broken** — [a bug report](https://github.com/lanterno/beats/issues/new/choose).
- **An idea** — [Discussions → Ideas](https://github.com/lanterno/beats/discussions/categories/ideas).
- **The daemon** — `beatsd doctor` checks the pairing, the API and the permissions, and
  says what's wrong. [daemon/README.md](../daemon/README.md) has every command.
